name: Jared J. Baldes
background: Jared J. Baldes of Riverton ran as the Libertarian nominee for governor of Wyoming in 2022 and lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election. His Secretary of State general-election filing listed a Riverton mailing address. No public-record occupation, education, or military service from the 2022 campaign period was confirmed in the filings and coverage reviewed for this Profile.
